page0.text: It's only nine in the morning, but the area around the station is already busy.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page0:1

page1.text:
Most of the shops don't open until around ten o'clock, but cafes and smaller bookshops are starting to open up.
There are already more people here than you'd expect in Miyama, even if it were a weekend.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page1:1

page2.text:
"..."
We get off the bus, and Saber looks around the area, displeased.
I don't blame her.
She hasn't really agreed to the whole date thing, and everyone is staring at her now.
I doubt she loves that.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page2:1

page3.text:
"Crap. I should've figured this might happen if I brought Saber here in the morning."
But this discomfort is bound to follow us around all day.
The only cure for this I can think of is Saber enjoying herself so much she forgets all the awkwardness.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page3:1

page4.text:
"...All right."
I smack my fist into my hand and look over to Saber.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page4:1

page5.text: "Saber, before we start, is there anywhere you'd like to go? We came all the way out here, so we can do whatever you want today."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page5:1

page6.text: "No, there is nothing. This place holds no particular interest to me, and I have little knowledge about it with which to make any other decisions."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page6:1

page7.text: "Are you sure? Well this is going to be tough. Then I really do just have to wing it. If you don't want to go anywhere, and I don't know where to go, things are looking kinda grim."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page7:1

page8.text:
"I hope you are not saying you have made no plans for today, Shirou."
"Hm? Well, I have some plans, but they're a little light on details. For the time being, let's just hit up as many shops as we can."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page8:1

page9.text:
That's...kinda hard too.
I know some stores I'd enjoy, but I have no idea what girls like.
Honestly, if I'd known this would happen to me someday, it'd have been smart to go out with a girl from class at least once.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page9:1

page10.text: "I do not intend to object, but there is something wrong with you, Shirou. I would not have thought much had you suggested to take a break. But that you have no plan for this interlude is completely ridiculous."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page10:1

page11.text:
Crap, now Saber's in lecturing mode.
This is the first time she's ever given me such an earful outside the dojo.
She wasn't into this from the start, and I figured all the people staring at her wouldn't help, but I didn't realize it'd be this bad.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page11:1

page12.text:
"I have been waiting for the opportunity to bring up your lack of planning. You may be keenly aware of the people around you, but you care little for yourself.
Consequently, you end up paying the price for your lack of self-regard."
"Hey! Are you listening, Shirou!?"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page12:1

page13.text:
"I am. Bottom line is that you don't understand why you're here. Right, Saber?
I know the places I'm going to take you will bore you, so I don't blame you for not liking it."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page13:1

page14.text: "Er...um, it is not that, but I...I am only saying that now is not the time for this kind of thing."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page14:1

page15.text:
"I know that. But I'm also ignoring that since I've already decided to spend all day with you on a date, Saber.
I'm not going to change my mind, no matter what you say. That's that."
I look straight at Saber.
The only thing Saber can do is look back at me in shock.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page15:1

page16.text:
"But if you have something to say, I'll at least hear you out.
I'm sure you have things to say, and I'd appreciate it if you told me now. That way we won't have to worry about holding back later on.
If you say you don't want to go on a date with me, I'll think of something else we can do."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page16:1

page17.text:
"Uh...no, you do not need to go through all that trouble. I just...ah..."
It's odd, seeing Saber at a loss for words.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page17:1

page18.text:
"Well, if you have nothing to say, then let's go.
You don't get to get mad about where we go since you don't have any requests."
Maybe we should go to an aquarium. I hear those are popular.
That sounds good, so I grab Saber's hand.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page18:1

page19.text:
"U-um, Shirou!? I-I am not complaining, but I do not think it is necessary to hold hands!"
"Huh? Well we're wasting time here, so we're going to run a bit. And I'll guide you to where we're going, so follow me and don't let go."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page19:1

page20.text:
"Ah...um, but not like this...!"
I start running without waiting for Saber's reply.
I've been pretty clear with Saber, so no more being pathetic in front of her.
For now, I just need to escort her to every place I can think of.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page20:1

page21.text:
Saber's hand in mine, I run through the crowd.
Apparently, Saber's given up resisting, as she just follows obediently.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page21:1

page22.text:
It's a little before ten o'clock.
We have two hours until lunchtime, so I'm going to make the most of that and really knock Saber's socks off.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page22:1

page23.text: Those two hours were like a storm.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page23:1

page24.text:
First, we tried a boutique I'd normally never go to. Then we tried our hand at bowling while I taught her the rules.
I could't find the aquarium, but we fed birds at the park.
We visited an interesting antique shop that ended up being a lot of fun, and I maintain that not going to the movie theater was the right choice.
Anyway, I spent the whole time taking her places I figured a girl might like, and it was two hours of failure and defeat.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page24:1

page25.text:
However I tried to spin it, the day wasn't really shaping up to be a date.
It felt more like a battle to the death, in which the first person to give up loses.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page25:1

page26.text:
Wherever I took Saber, she acted exactly like she always has done. Once in a while, she would fall so quiet I would start to worry if she was truly angry.
Her lack of reaction made it clear she was not having fun, which pushed me to try even harder each time.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page26:1

page27.text: And so, I ran all around the city, desperate to make Saber smile, but noon came before I actually accomplished anything.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page27:1

page28.text:
And...
...with Saber's reminder that it's lunchtime, I decide to take a short break. However...
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page28:1

page29.text:
"What is this place...?"
I can't help but blurt it out as we sit down.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page29:1

page30.text:
"I suggest going to the coffee shop near the river for lunch."
That was the only advice Tohsaka gave me last night.
So I did as she suggested and picked this restaurant, but I never imagined it would be so pretentious.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page30:1

page31.text:
"..."
I take a look at the menu.
Luckily, the menu has Japanese translations next to all its foreign text, so I can at least figure out what all the dishes are.
The problem is that I've never even heard of any of these dishes, and the prices are outrageous.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page31:1

page32.text:
"Where are we? On Mars or something? I have no idea what to order."
I stare at the menu and growl.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page32:1

page33.text:
"Shirou? I thought we came here to eat lunch."
Saber looks and sounds a little concerned.
"Yeah, but this is really not what I expected."
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page33:1

page34.text:
I look up.
And what I see...
...is Saber, looking like a cornered rabbit.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page34:1

page35.text:
"Saber...?"
"If you are uneasy, we can head back to the mansion. I actually prefer the food you prepare, Shirou."
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page35:1

page36.text:
"Eh...? Does that mean you want to go home?"
"No. It is not that I want to go back, but I have been nervous all day, and am more tired than usual."
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page36:1

page37.text: "Really? Oh...I thought about going back out after we had lunch and a bit of a break, but if you're tired, maybe we should take a longer break here."
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page37:1

page38.text: "No...that is not what I mean! Tired is not quite the right word. It is more like...well..."
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page38:1

page39.text:
Saber stops.
Fortunately, I'm the only one who hears the faint squeak from her stomach.
Oh. She could've just told me she was hungry.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page39:1

page40.text:
"I am sorry. What I am trying to say is that I would appreciate it if we could eat lunch as soon as possible."
"Got it. Yeah, it may not be interesting, but let's order whatever looks okay here so we can get our food quick."
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page40:1

page41.text:
It should be easy if a light snack is all we need.
I order two things that seem like lunch dishes, and we quickly eat.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page41:1

page42.text:
While I'm drinking my after meal coffee, I start thinking about what to do in the afternoon.
What I learned this morning is that physical stuff like bowling is no good.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page42:1

page43.text:
Saber is...extremely competitive.
That in itself is good. But Saber's looks already draw enough attention, and when she gets like that, well, she stands out even more.
After we finished a game, Saber got sulky because of all the attention she drew.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page43:1

page44.text:
"So we're going to avoid physical activities...
Hey Saber. I'm going to ask you again: Is there anywhere you want to go?"
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page44:1

page45.text: "Me? No, nowhere in particular. I do not know my way around, so I will keep following you."
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page45:1

page46.text:
Saber lifts her teacup as she speaks.
She ordered black tea to have after her meal, and it seems she enjoys its flavor.
I hardly serve black tea at home, and even if I did, it'd just be cheap tea bags.
Saber must not have been satisfied with the drinks I've been serving at home, since it looks like she prefers black tea.
Well, I should be more mindful about that starting tonight.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page46:1

page47.text:
...
Saber isn't doing much...she's just drinking her tea.
She doesn't seem particularly happy, but she doesn't exactly look bored either.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page47:1

page48.text:
I guess she's just...being Saber.
As sunlight pours in through the window, Saber sits up straight, gracefully sipping from her teacup.
It's the first time I've seen her do this, but it seems so natural it's like I've seen it a million times before.
I don't know why I'm thinking that.
Saber, at least as I know her, is always serious, only focused on wielding her sword, on fighting.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page48:1

page49.text:
"Oh, I get it."
It's only natural.
I only think of her as the girl who takes up her sword.
The moment she sets her sword aside, Saber is always calm and gentle.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page49:1

page50.text:
This scene doesn't feel new or unnatural me because it's just...her being who she is.
No matter how skilled a swordsman she is, this is Saber just being normal.
Or...wielding her sword isn't what makes her exceptional.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page50:1

page51.text:
I once thought while I was dreaming that she was suited for fighting.
I don't think I'm wrong there.
No matter how great her sword skills are...no matter how many battlefields she's been on...
...as long as she was really herself, she couldn't have found the battlefield a comfortable place to be.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page51:1

page52.text:
That's why this is how it's supposed to be.
Saber is not wielding a sword... She is just resting and unwinding.
She belongs in this serene setting.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-08:page52:1
